patch.expected_behavior: For local CSV tasks that provide column_types and select this Skill, declared string columns preserve CSV text such as id "001", while non-empty declared number cells convert to numeric values. The Skill's references/csv-policy.json supplies preserve_string_columns and empty_numeric_as_null policy settings; empty numeric cells map to null only when that policy is used. This proposal claims target and regression coverage only, not transfer verification.

checks: case:leading-zeros: verify id is the string "001" and amount is the numeric value 10.0 using exact value and type comparison.
case:numeric-regression: verify id "a" remains text and amount "2.5" is emitted as numeric 2.5.
No public check material is available for an empty number cell under empty_numeric_as_null; do not claim transfer verification until such a check is provided.
exceptions: If a number-column non-empty cell cannot be parsed as a number, follow the task-specific invalid-value instruction; do not silently reclassify it as string.
The empty-number-to-null behavior is conditional on the task using empty_numeric_as_null.
preconditions: Read the task column_types mapping before converting cell values.
Read references/csv-policy.json before applying CSV conversion policy.

applies_when: The task provides a CSV input and a column_types mapping.
The selected Skill assets include references/csv-policy.json.
exclusions: Do not infer a numeric type for a column declared as string.
Do not apply empty_numeric_as_null unless the task uses that policy.

steps: Parse CSV cells as text initially.
For each column declared string, preserve each non-null CSV cell as text without numeric inference; retain leading zeros.
For each column declared number, convert non-empty numeric text to a numeric value.
When empty_numeric_as_null is enabled for the task, emit null for empty cells in columns declared number.
Serialize output values so declared string values remain strings and converted number values remain numeric.
content.title: Convert CSV values using declared column types
triggers: A CSV transformation task supplies declared types such as string and number.
A task requires preservation of string identifiers or conversion of number columns.

patch.reason: The current snapshot has no Skills or CSV policy asset, while observed CSV outputs converted a declared string leading-zero identifier as though it were numeric. This adds a local CSV Skill and its required policy asset for declared-type conversion. The empty-number policy is documented as conditional, but is not asserted as verified because no public transfer check is available.
